body.text: We are grateful for the opportunity to present our capabilities, recognize that clarifications may be needed and welcome a discussion on any aspect of this proposal.

Crestline Realty manages leasing in **Yardi Voyager**, finance in **Oracle E-Business Suite** and sales in **Salesforce**, with budgets and forecasts maintained in Excel on SharePoint. Month-end reporting today depends on manual consolidation across these systems and takes six to eight working days, which delays decisions on occupancy, collections and cash flow.

AutomatonsX proposes to implement an enterprise data platform on **Microsoft Fabric** that brings all four sources into a single governed OneLake foundation. The platform follows a Bronze, Silver and Gold medallion design, with certified semantic models feeding twelve Power BI dashboards for leasing, collections, sales pipeline and finance.

Governance is built in from the start. **Microsoft Purview** will catalog the estate, publish a business glossary, track lineage from source to report and apply sensitivity labels to tenant personal data. The engagement is planned over sixteen weeks and closes with knowledge transfer so Crestline's team can extend the platform with confidence.

items: **Integrate core business systems**: Ingest Yardi Voyager, Oracle EBS, Salesforce and finance workbooks into OneLake on a reliable daily cadence with faster refresh during month end.
**Establish a governed lakehouse**: Build Bronze, Silver and Gold layers in Fabric with consistent naming, data quality checks and reconciliation against source totals.
**Shorten month-end reporting**: Replace manual Excel consolidation with automated pipelines so finance can close and report within one to two days.
**Enable self-service analytics**: Deliver three certified semantic models and twelve Power BI dashboards with row-level security by community and business unit.
**Protect tenant data**: Classify and label tenant personal data in Purview and restrict access through Entra ID role-based controls.
**Build internal capability**: Hand over runbooks, documentation and hands-on training so Crestline's team can operate and extend the platform.

body.text: AutomatonsX experts help customers get the most out of their public cloud investment, the agility, flexibility and scalability the cloud offers, without it becoming your core business. Public cloud customers trust AutomatonsX for proven expertise in data solutions and a results-obsessed, customer-first approach. AutomatonsX consistently delivers high-quality results and end-to-end support to ensure cloud excellence, prevent downtime and ensure greater resilience. Our proposed solution for Crestline Realty is informed by several key guiding principles:

rows: Transform and load data in accordance with defined requirements and data mappings; standardize metrics.
Processes that scale to ever-expanding data via a common extraction framework; data volumes gracefully handled.
Processes supportable by anyone with base-level skills.
Load and access data quickly, minimizing impact on other processes.

Effective handling of data-quality, cloud-service and connection problems without significant impact.

body.text: **Raw (Bronze) layer:** stores a one-to-one copy of source data in its original, unprocessed form with basic quality gates, a single repository for all data, supporting structured, semi-structured and unstructured formats. Validation is limited to basic quality & completeness checks.

**Integrated (Silver) layer:** the curated layer where data is cleaned, transformed and enriched for consistency, accuracy and completeness, used for exploration, preparation and data-quality analysis. More structured than Bronze; the data model is designed business-use-case-agnostic.

**Use-case (Gold) layer:** the trusted, ready-to-consume layer where models are prepared for business needs and decision-making. Highly structured, consistent, reliable, the single source of truth for the organization.
**Data delivery layer:** provides logic and processes user requests, APIs, web services, downstream systems, visualization, microservices.
**Job Orchestration:** managing and coordinating execution of data-processing jobs, scheduling, monitoring, dependency management, error/exception handling.

**Traceability & reconciliation:** data lineage and audit trails (where data came from, who accessed it, what processing steps, where stored) plus reconciliation comparing datasets to ensure consistency and accuracy.
**Constraint checks:** automated validation that data meets defined rules and relationships.
**Runtime Audits:** checks during processing to ensure jobs run efficiently and produce accurate results; surface bottlenecks and resource issues.
**Housekeeping:** archiving and purging to keep the lake clean, efficient, performant and cost-optimized.

For Crestline, the data sources layer covers Yardi Voyager, Oracle EBS, Salesforce and finance workbooks. The ingestion layer uses Fabric Data Pipelines and an on-premises data gateway for Oracle, landing data into OneLake.

The lakehouse layer holds Bronze, Silver and Gold zones with Spark notebooks for transformation. Purview provides the governance and metadata layer, while Fabric monitoring and alerting cover orchestration and operations.

**Consumption**: Direct Lake semantic models serve Power BI dashboards and mobile reports
**Governance**: Purview scans, classifies and traces lineage across every layer
